description: Violates G1 / G4 (verification-contract.md §4.3, §4.4): gates.verificationIsMandatory is declared false — the declaration asserts verification is skippable, weakening a mandatory gate. Verification is a transition that cannot be skipped, not an optional command; a standard adds checks, it never weakens gates. The schema encodes the rejection as a const-true gate declaration: 'false' fails the const.
